releaseNotes:
## Conferences
- Simplified family editing and participant room cards, with clearer shared travel and member review.
- Couples use both names; larger families use the family surname, matching normal bookings.
- Corrected family entries in Weekly and Monthly, room assignments, travel exceptions and adult/child counts.
- Overview shows compact room lists, in-house guests and peak daily day guests, including unnamed guests.
- Email conversations stay on Overview, with a link from Edit event.
- Meals by day uses a compact layout with expandable bulk day-guest tools.

## Meals
- Meal planner and printed plans show meal times, using conference overrides where set.

## Data
- Preserves existing conference membership, individual meals, Contacts links and historical booking snapshots.
